rows.grounds: rathasya (chariot, m.gen.sg) + ārohaṇa (ascent) + artha (purpose/for, n.acc.sg) + tu (indecl. particle); 'for the purpose of ascending the chariot'
sopāna (stair/step) + ākṛti (form/shape), compound adjective; 'stair-like, having the form of stairs'
adjective meaning 'similar, resembling'; agrees with sopānākṛti/sannibham context
